metadata.title: Command Integrity

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring that only authorized, authentic, and safe commands are executed by OT systems.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: OT protocol security, command validation, and industrial communications control technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for validating the authenticity, integrity, and safety of commands sent to OT systems.

props.name: safety-principle
props.remarks: Only commands that are authorized, intact, and safety‑compliant may be executed by OT control systems.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Command integrity mitigates malicious command injection and unsafe control actions in OT environments.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Relevant ATT&CK tactics include Defense Evasion and Impact affecting industrial control systems.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: Command integrity aligns with D3FEND command validation and control flow enforcement techniques.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Defensive techniques ensuring OT commands are authentic, intact, and safely executed.

metadata.remarks: Command Integrity defines how OT systems ensure that only authorized and uncompromised commands are accepted and executed. This pattern protects against unsafe, malicious, or malformed control actions that could result in physical harm or system instability. IEC 62443 provides the authoritative security requirements.

components.title: Command Authentication
components.description: Verification that commands originate from authorized and trusted control entities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: OT systems verify the authenticity of command sources before accepting control actions.

components.title: Command Integrity and Validation
components.description: Validation that commands are not altered, malformed, or inconsistent with expected operation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: OT systems protect the integrity of command messages to prevent tampering or corruption.

components.title: Command Execution Controls
components.description: Enforcement of safe execution boundaries and rejection of unsafe or out-of-sequence commands.

implemented-requirements.remarks: OT systems enforce execution constraints to prevent unsafe or unauthorized control actions.
